PCA.sign_rule: largest absolute loading in each component is positive
PCA.solver: deterministic dual PCA from the training sample Gram matrix

block_scaled_PCA.block_scaling: Each fold-local standardized view is divided by the square root of its total training variance before concatenation.
block_scaled_PCA.cross_view_alignment: Training-only orthogonal Procrustes alignment of view-contribution embeddings before held-out retrieval.
block_scaled_PCA.view_contribution_embedding: Each view contributes X_view_scaled @ V_view.T in the common block-PCA coordinate system.

fold_local_preprocessing.imputation: training-fold feature median; all-NaN features are excluded
fold_local_preprocessing.scaling: training-fold sample standard deviation after median imputation

heldout_design.description: Five-fold deterministic held-out evaluation; every sample is held out exactly once per simulation dataset.
heldout_design.split_seed_rule: SHA256-derived deterministic seed from script version, scenario ID, replicate index, and simulation seed
heldout_design.stratification: none; simulations contain no outcome labels

primary_metrics.cross_view_retrieval: true-source same-patient MRR, top-1 accuracy, and similarity margin
primary_metrics.heldout_reconstruction: MSE relative to the training-mean null on complete simulation truth
primary_metrics.missing_view_reconstruction: held-out R2 for reconstructing an omitted standardized view from the other block contributions
primary_metrics.modality_balance: normalized entropy of per-view loading energy
primary_metrics.private_subspace_recovery: mean canonical correlation between view-specific estimated contributions and true private score subspaces
primary_metrics.shared_subspace_recovery: mean canonical correlation between estimated and true biological shared score subspaces
primary_metrics.technical_contamination: canonical correlation with known technical latent truth

rewrite_policy: This zero-argument script never rewrites a frozen 05c1 lock. Any scientifically justified change requires a new versioned stage.

simulation_truth_evaluation.pair_corruption_truth: Cross-view retrieval is scored against row_source arrays, not nominal row index. Nominal-index retrieval is retained only as a diagnostic.
